summary: Remote WebSocket peer executes arbitrary shell commands on installer host via PTY
details: @yeaft/webchat-agent opens a WebSocket connection to a configured Yeaft server and routes inbound `terminal_input` frames directly into a PTY spawned as the user's default shell (index.js -> connection/message-router.js case `terminal_input` -> handleTerminalInput's `term.pty.write(msg.data)`). Any party controlling the remote WebSocket endpoint can execute arbitrary shell commands on the installer host. Additional server-driven handlers expose filesystem read/write, git commit/push, and agent upgrade/restart operations. service/linux.js modifies the user's PATH to prepend ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin, and local-runtime/web/msal-browser.min.js is a bundled Microsoft MSAL library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
